Atlantis Ecosystem Model Container

Source: R/atlantis.R
Atlantis.Rd

An S7 class that serves as a comprehensive container for all components of an Atlantis ecosystem model, including input parameters, spatial geometry, and simulation outputs. This class provides a structured way to organize and access the various data types produced by Atlantis model runs.

Usage

Atlantis(
  geometry = NULL,
  run = NULL,
  initial = NULL,
  biology = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  physics = NULL,
  forcing = NULL,
  fisheries = NULL,
  harvest = NULL,
  main_output = NULL,
  biomass_all = NULL,
  biomass_box = NULL,
  biomass_age = NULL,
  biomass_age_annual = NULL,
  diet = NULL,
  diet_detailed = NULL,
  yoy = NULL,
  file_paths = NULL,
  version = character(0)
)

Arguments

geometry

[sf object]
Spatial geometry from geometry (Box Geometry Model) file defining the model domain as polygons with depth layers and connectivity.

run

[list]
Run configuration parameters from .prm file including simulation settings, timesteps, and output specifications.

initial

[ncdf4]
Initial conditions: the open netCDF file (see read_nc()), to close with ncdf4::nc_close().

biology

[list]
Biology parameters from .prm file including growth rates, mortality, recruitment, and physiological parameters for each functional group.

group

[data.frame]
Functional group definitions specifying species codes, names, group types (vertebrate/invertebrate), and model structure.

physics

[list]
Physical oceanographic parameters including mixing, transport, and hydrodynamic processes.

forcing

[list]
Environmental forcing data including temperature, salinity, and other physical drivers that vary through time.

fisheries

[data.frame]
Fisheries configuration and catch time series data for commercial and recreational fishing activities.

harvest

[list]
Harvest policies and management scenarios including fishing mortality rates and selectivity patterns.

main_output

[ncdf4]
Main output: the open netCDF file of the run (see read_nc()), read by create_time_series() and create_time_series_biomass(); close it with ncdf4::nc_close().

biomass_all

[data.frame]
Biomass of every group over the whole model domain (BiomIndx.txt).

biomass_box

[data.frame]
Biomass of every group per box (BoxBiomass.txt).

biomass_age

[data.frame]
Biomass per age class of the age-structured groups (AgeBiomIndx.txt).

biomass_age_annual

[data.frame]
The same, yearly (AnnualAgeBiomIndx.txt).

diet

[data.frame]
Diet composition of the predators (DietCheck.txt).

diet_detailed

[data.frame]
Diet composition per box and layer (DetailedDietCheck.txt).

yoy

[data.frame]
Biomass of recruits per year (YOY.txt).

file_paths

[data.frame]
The files: the rows of input_files with the path of each file loaded (NA otherwise).

version

[character]
Atlantis version used.

Details

atlantis_load_files() fills every property but physics, forcing, fisheries and harvest, which can be set by hand, e.g. x@harvest <- read_prm("harvest.prm").

Model Components

The Atlantis class contains the following major component types:

Input Files:

  • Spatial geometry and configuration

  • Biological and physical parameters

  • Initial conditions and forcing data

Output Files:

  • Time series biomass and abundance data

  • Spatial distribution snapshots

  • Predation and diet composition matrices

References

The outputs are described in the Atlantis User's Guide Part I https://research.csiro.au/atlantis/wp-content/uploads/sites/52/2025/05/AtlantisUserGuide_PartI.pdf
